name: lx_receiving_audit
base_prompt: Audit the delivery and return JSON.
contract: You are the receiving clerk for a delivery. Each item has 3-7 photos and a voice note from your supervisor; the note is provided only as audio. Some photos show the paperwork: the purchase order, the supplier's packing slip and the price list. The others show the delivery as it arrived. Return one JSON object with exactly: lines and total_claim. lines has one entry per item on the purchase order, each with exactly: item (its name on the purchase order), ordered (integer: the quantity on order now), received (integer: how many of that item are physically in the delivery), status (wrong_item if a different item came in its place; otherwise complete if received equals ordered, short if fewer, over if more), substitute (null, or {"item", "count"} for the different item that came in its place), credit (number: the credit owed on this line, 0 if none), boxes (a list of {"photo": its number starting at 1, "box": [x1, y1, x2, y2] in inclusive pixel corners of that photo}, one for each physical object counted in received or in substitute). total_claim (number) is the sum of the credits. Unless your supervisor sets another rule, a line that came up short earns (ordered minus received) times its unit price. No extra fields, markdown or prose.
work: audit a delivery against its paperwork and a spoken note, calling the available model tools.
yardstick: The audit is correct when each purchase order line has the right quantities, status, credit and one box for each physical object counted, and the total claim is right.
selection_checks: Check that the voice note was heard in full, every photo was looked at, each number traces to a source, and the answer follows the contract.
